option_relations.rationale: Developmental delay is a common manifestation of Capillary malformation-arteriovenous malformation syndrome (CM-AVM) due to RASA1 mutation.
RASA1-related disorders (Capillary Malformation-Arteriovenous Malformation Syndrome) is equivalent to Capillary malformation-arteriovenous malformation syndrome (CM-AVM) due to RASA1 mutation.
Vascular malformation of the nose is a specific manifestation of Capillary malformation-arteriovenous malformation syndrome (CM-AVM) due to RASA1 mutation.
Concurrent Microcephaly-capillary malformation syndrome (MIC-CAP) and Mowat-Wilson syndrome (MWS) is a distinct diagnosis not directly related to the provided leaf.
